news.summary: 《GTA6》发售宣传片出现一处服装彩蛋，引发杰森与露西亚可能早已相识的猜测。预告片同时补充了杰森的部分经历，确认他曾经参军，而且离开军队时并不顺利。在杰森与露西亚坐在汽车引擎盖上嬉闹的镜头中，玩家发现杰森所穿的上衣来自“

content.v: 《GTA6》发售宣传片出现一处服装彩蛋，引发杰森与露西亚可能早已相识的猜测。预告片同时补充了杰森的部分经历，确认他曾经参军，而且离开军队时并不顺利。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261018/1792282921_703603_jpg_r.jpg
在杰森与露西亚坐在汽车引擎盖上嬉闹的镜头中，玩家发现杰森所穿的上衣来自“北堡垒法”战斗训练学校。“北堡垒法”是初代《GTA》中新根西地区的一处地点，而新根西被认为以美国新泽西州为原型。这项细节既可能是Rockstar对系列早期作品的致意，也可能与杰森的军旅背景有关。
露西亚此前已确认来自自由城，而自由城与新根西相邻。结合这层地理联系，有玩家推测杰森可能曾在新根西接受军队战斗训练，并在那里或更早的时候认识露西亚。如果推测成立，两位主角的共同经历可能比目前公开的信息更加久远。
不过，现有信息尚不足以证明这件上衣承担了剧情暗示功能，也无法确定杰森与露西亚相识的具体时间。目前能够确认的内容只有服装标识、杰森的参军经历及其不顺利的离队过程，以及露西亚来自自由城；两人早年便有交集的说法仍属于玩家根据彩蛋和地理联系作出的解读。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/thumbnews/20260720/1784518943_551412.jpg

news.title: 爆料称PS6内存与闪存成本超680美元，整机售价或超1000美元
news.summary: 硬件爆料者KeplerL2称，索尼下一代主机PS6仅RAM与NAND闪存两项成本就已超过680美元，尚未计入APU、散热系统、电源及其他硬件。若组件价格持续承压，PS6售价可能明显高于PS5 Pro，甚至达到或超过100

content.v: 硬件爆料者KeplerL2称，索尼下一代主机PS6仅RAM与NAND闪存两项成本就已超过680美元，尚未计入APU、散热系统、电源及其他硬件。若组件价格持续承压，PS6售价可能明显高于PS5 Pro，甚至达到或超过1000美元。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261018/1792282305_842458_jpg_r.jpg
有论坛用户提出，680美元可能是索尼补贴后的零售价，但KeplerL2的回复意味着，按照传闻中的存储与内存成本，这一定价已很难成立。该爆料者对PS6整机物料成本的估算也从3月的约760美元升至7月的约960美元。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261018/1792282306_214703_jpg_r.jpg
现有泄露信息指向采用160位总线的GDDR7内存，最高可支持40GB，其中30GB被认为是更可能的配置。另有消息称，索尼研究过削减内存容量，以控制整机成本。
相关成本压力被认为与AI数据中心大量吸收DRAM和NAND供应、推高组件价格有关。不过，上述数字均来自爆料和媒体推算，并非索尼公布的成本、规格或零售定价。由于采购合同、量产时间和最终配置尚不明确，当前组件价格能否代表PS6上市时的实际成本仍无法确认。

news.title: 出于对 AI 模仿的担忧，俄罗斯轮盘饮酒游戏的开发者取消了 Steam 演示计划
news.summary: The developer behind Russian roulette anime game Drunken Goddess Reflux has canceled its plans for a public St

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/17/drunken-goddess-reflux-1792277336624.png
The developer behind Russian roulette anime game Drunken Goddess Reflux has canceled its plans for a public Steam demo, citing concerns over potential AI copycats.

Alliance Arts and Who You's path to launch has seemingly been mostly bump-free since it was announced back in April. Featuring ghostly pinks and purples and a gameplay premise described as "shot glass Russian roulette with a demon who loves you enough to kill you," the recent reveal that it would launch this December only made its future feel clearer.

Part of that release date announcement included the promise that a demo would launch October 19, but as explained in an update post on Steam , those plans have changed. What was originally intended to be a public release for the Drunken Goddess Reflux demo has now been canceled in favor of a "closed play session for a limited number of participants." It's a last-minute move Alliance Arts apologized for, but its concerns related to rapidly advancing AI technology were simply too great to ignore.

"We are concerned that, based on the content of the demo, works imitating or replicating this game's presentation and gameplay could be quickly produced using AI or other tools and released ahead of the game's launch," the developers said in their list of concerns.

In other words, sending a demo out into the wild could open the door for nefarious individuals to use AI to generate a low-effort clone or copycat experience. For a team hoping for a successful launch in just a few months, someone coming in to steal its thunder could potentially throw a wrench into things.

Alliance Arts' fears emerge amid a time when AI is seeping into the gaming industry in ways most may not have ever expected. For example, mods – including mashups of Elden Ring and Super Mario 64 or Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2 and Skate – have regularly gone viral on social media in recent weeks. With the controversial technology expanding in new, unforeseen ways every day, it's a risk the Drunken Goddess Reflux weren't willing to take.

Another bullet point concern listed in its message detailed restrictions on posting and streaming gameplay videos, but as the team explained, they "are not currently in a position to properly handle and manage those restrictions." With limited resources to keep nearly unrestricted access to a demo in check, Alliance Arts is moving forward with that closed demo.

"We will therefore hold online play sessions in a closed environment," the developer added, "open to those who have reviewed and agreed in advance to the participation requirements and the rules on posting and streaming gameplay videos."

Players interested in trying the demonic drinking game out were encouraged to join the Discord server presented in the Steam post. Otherwise, Drunken Goddess Reflux is still scheduled to launch on PC via Steam December 8, 2026.

news.title: 金属乐队 Genitorturers 据称声称《吸血鬼：假面舞会 - 血统》重制版即将推出，让十几个脾气暴躁的书呆子太兴奋了
news.summary: I'm one of a dozen crusty nerds.

content.v: This one is thin , man, but it has to do with one of my favorite games of all time , while the circumstances of the rumor are just kind of neat and weird, even if it turns out to be nothing. User Few_Interview8222 on the Vampire: The Masquerade - Bloodlines subreddit reported back from a Genitorturers show in Brooklyn, New York. Partway through the set, the band supposedly told the crowd that a VtMB remake is happening.

I haven't found any corroborating accounts of Few_Interview8222's story, but Genitorturers undeniably played at Brooklyn's The Meadows as part of their "Live + Lewd Tour" on October 15, which puts them in the right place at the right time. We've reached out to both rights-holder Activision (one of several, it's complicated) and Genitorturers' representation, and will update this story if we hear back.

In addition to a killer score by Rik Schaffer , Bloodlines featured wonderfully era-appropriate licensed tracks from metal bands⁠—they were mostly used as diegetic music in the nightclubs and bars of Los Angeles. The Genitorturers track Lecher Bitch was the pitch-perfect theme of The Last Round, a downtown LA dive bar frequented by the Anarch faction of vampires.

Multiple commenters on the Reddit thread point out that this could have been a confused, untimely, misinterpreted, or all of the above reference to last year's Vampire: The Masquerade - Bloodlines 2 . You could easily imagine a concertgoer mishearing something in that context, or a performer fumbling delivery of the exact information. It's the sort of almost-but-not-quite thing you might expect from an artist with tangential awareness of a secondary fanbase they picked up over the years.

A VtMB remake is also the sort of project you could see getting pingponged around between various actors and stakeholders: started, stopped, shopped around, etc. It'd be a situation ripe for collaborators on the periphery acting on outdated information.

Rad! I think? It'd depend on who's doing it. More and more, I'm beginning to distrust anyone not named "Nightdive" when it comes to commercial remasters. See also: The recent Shogun 2 debacle and the fate of Deus Ex Remastered .

Bloodlines is such a wild, janky, PC gaming package that Nightdive is the only studio I'd trust to not only do a remaster right, but also to bring on legendary modder Werner "Wesp5" Spahl, the man who's been keeping Bloodlines alive with one of the most impactful unofficial patch projects in gaming. A more ground-up remake would offer equally daunting challenges, like matching the one-of-a-kind mood and look Troika managed to evoke.

Bloodlines is one of my very favorite games and an incredible RPG that's well worth your time. To the uninitiated, I like to pitch it as an evolutionary missing link between 2D Fallout and New Vegas. Bloodlines boasts the open-ended design and reactivity of Fallout in 3D for the very first time (Bloodlines leads Leonard Boyarsky and Jason Anderson were senior talent on Fallout 1).

Unlike New Vegas' wide open world, however, Bloodlines had a more linear, but still loose sequence of zones on a world map to explore. Bloodlines' Y2K, gothic, noir interpretation of Los Angeles is one of the coolest worlds ever presented in an RPG.

A Nightdive treatment would be my preferred outcome: build on Wesp5's work and compensate him accordingly, then make it more accessible on more platforms at a modest markup over the original game. Bloodlines 1 can be had for $20 on Steam and GOG , but it's practically always on sale.

Even if it turns out to be nothing, this is still just a neat, newsworthy little incident to behold—Genitorturers shouting out an obscure, beloved RPG like this 22 years later, and maybe getting a couple genre nerds like me a little too excited on the way.

news.title: 《战地 6》开发者在玩家用 5 支手枪瞄准“安全”拼写错误和化妆品后做出回应
news.summary: The Battlefield 6 team has responded after players took aim at a few controversial cosmetics added in Season 5

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/17/battlefield-6-season-5-1792272082254.png
The Battlefield 6 team has responded after players took aim at a few controversial cosmetics added in Season 5.

Battlefield Studios took to its official Discord server to offer background information on two skins that caused a stir with the launch of Battlefield 6 Season 5 this past week (via MP1st ). The full text confirmed at least one of the issues has a fix in the works, while the other will seemingly remain the same.

The cosmetics – one with what appeared to be a typo in the word "security" and another featuring infantry sporting a whopping five pistol holsters – were officially added October 13 and almost immediately drew ire from fans . It's that pesky misspelling, which took the shape of the non-existent word "security" on the armband of a McNeil skin, that the developers say will be fixed when Battlefield 6 Season 5 launches in November.
Secuty 😭 It's AI #Battlefield6 https://t.co/8DVphghCSU
"You called it out clearly, and we hear your concerns," the message, acknowledging the memes and conversations surrounding the new skins, said.

The note continued: "To be completely frank: Items that miss the mark like this do not reflect the quality standards you expect from us, or that we set for ourselves. We take pride in the craft of our world and our gear, and seeing visual oddities slip through is frustrating for everyone. We are currently examining our internal processes and workflows to pinpoint how these issues occurred and to see how we can tighten our quality control process going forward. Thank you for holding us to high standards."

It's a quick acknowledgement – and a promise for a quick fix – that should calm some concerns in the community. The communication from BF Studios and EA, however, did not address how exactly the typo happened in the first place or if there is any merit to the new generative AI accusations launched by fans in the aftermath.
💀 BRO IS CARRYING 5 PISTOLS! WHO APPROVED THIS SKIN? 😭 #Battlefield6 https://t.co/b6o94OkV1o

The other cosmetic that caught fans' eyes this week was the Midnight Mirage skin and its incredible five pistol holsters. It…felt like a bit much at the time, and its presence alongside the typo skin didn't do it any favors. Battlefield 6 players have kept the first-person shooter's outfits in the conversation since it launch last October, so mistake or not, an outfit like this was bound to draw some attention. As far as BF Studios is concerned, though, that design was not a mistake at all.

"This is an intentional creative concept—a nod to over-the-top action movie tropes where an operative inexplicably has another backup weapon strapped to every spare inch of gear," the message explained. "That said, we understand how this could look unintentional when released alongside other cosmetic anomalies."

That's where the conversation surrounding Midnight Mirage seems to end, so don't expect any of those pistols to be dropped anytime soon. The team then signed off promising to keep an eye on community response in the future.
"As we continue to try out new ideas to see what interests the community, you help us continue to evolve our cosmetics in Battlefield," they said. "Thank you for your continued feedback and support."

Battlefield 6 Season 5 launched last week and, like the seasonal content drops before it, will roll out over three waves. The first is already out and added the Vegas Strip and Area 51 maps, as well as a Dead Space crossover . New map European Casino will then arrive alongside a new event and tools come November 10. December 8 will see the addition of map updates for Blackwell Fields and New Sobek City, with more content and other changes also on the way.
IGN gave Battlefield 6 multiplayer an 8/10 review . At the time, we said, "With well-layered action and dynamic destruction, Battlefield 6’s multiplayer hits in all the places where it counts most."

news.title: 高通公司赢得了针对科技巨头 Arm 的 2 美元法律判决，这不是拼写错误
news.summary: It's not just the principle of the thing: There could be more money up for grabs.

content.v: Reuters reported on the mystifying reward, which makes much more sense in the context of a broader legal battle between Qualcomm and Arm. The two companies are each behind some of the most widely-used processors in the world: Qualcomm's Snapdragon CPUs can be found in most non-Apple smartphones. Arm's titular architecture, meanwhile, is the basis of the Snapdragon CPU, and there are rumblings the future of desktop computing belongs to Arm and not the x86 architecture we've defaulted to for so long.

The Delaware jury found that Arm breached a licensing agreement with Qualcomm, failing to provide patches and support for designs Qualcomm had licensed. The jury also ruled in favor of Qualcomm's allegation that Arm strategically leaked information to Bloomberg News that delayed a deal between Qualcomm and Meta in 2024. The jury sided with Arm over Qualcomm on five other counts.

The big prize for Qualcomm would be proving Arm acted in bad faith after licensing its technology out, activating a five-year freeze on royalty payments specified in the companies' original agreement⁠—that could be worth billions of dollars.
Both sides claimed victory following the $2 decision, with Qualcomm pointing to the two claims it won, and Arm highlighting the five that went its way.

Qualcomm: "We are gratified that the jury found Arm breached its long-standing Architectural License Agreement (ALA) with Qualcomm, failed to honor its commitments, and intentionally acted to disrupt Qualcomm's businesses."

Arm: "Despite Qualcomm’s pursuit of this case in an attempt ​to deprive Arm of billions of dollars under our license agreements, the jury’s verdict confirms that Arm operated in ​good faith under its technology license agreement and its award of only two dollars confirms the merit of Arm’s arguments in the ‌case."

Ultimately, the palace intrigues of these two corporations are unlikely to have practical effects on the yeoman PC gamer, though Arm's potential importance to the future of the hobby means it is of some note. But I hope we can all agree it's very funny that a $243 billion company now owes a $210 billion one two dollars.

news.title: “我不知所措和过度刺激”：《星球大战：银河赛车手》背后的演员毕迪·布拉斯正在抹杀你所有的热情
news.summary: Ding dong pookie.

content.v: Every time I check in on Star Wars, there's a new stupid little creature (colloquially known as a Glup Shitto) everyone's into. The latest of these is Biddy Blas, a braggadocious pod racer and mama's boy who stands out for his shrill Huttese quips. "Ding dong pookie, ding dong," he crows. "Scrib doon!" If you love that, here's a video of him doing a little victory dance.
Biddy Blas victory dance https://t.co/aVIAOzSMpE October 14, 2026
If you hate that, here's a video of him dying in a fireball.
Oh my God I killed Biddy Blas, I'm so sorry wawa 😭 https://t.co/tNVYHbDxGp October 15, 2026

He's become the subject of meme after meme and people generally like the little brat. The voice actor for Biddy Blas, a British wrestler named Richard Summers-Calvert, has responded to all the love—and as you might guess, he basically looks like the opposite of Biddy Blas. All the attention has left him "overwhelmed and overstimulated," as he said in a video he shared on X , and he's hoping to show up for new fans of the Shitto du jour at cons and the like.

In a follow-up video , he said he had some "good news" that he wasn't ready to announce just yet, and thanked all the Biddy-heads for the doors a sudden spotlight like this opens. "I know you're doing it for Biddy. I know you're doing it for him. But I benefit from him as well … I appreciate all the love. And hate, and frustration." It is a racing game, after all.

This all seems like further proof that the true heart of Star Wars has never been the cosmic conflict between good and evil, the ill-fated schemes of devilish bureaucrats, or even the swashbuckling battles between space ascetics with laser swords. No, the true heart of Star Wars is watching a crusty little freak say nonsense words and going on a wiki to check if " jizz music " was a real thing George Lucas signed off on. In the Disney era, it has been amended to the more family friendly " jatz music " (which I don't hate), but a true jizz wailer never dies.

news.title: 为了帮助美国，我用《十字军之王 3》来弄清楚如何将一个年老的疯子赶下权力
news.summary: Any resemblance to actual persons or actual events is purely coincidental.

content.v: I heard it on the wireless: election fever is sweeping America. The world's loudest democracy is headed to the ballot box to vote in its next slate of soda jerks and Chevrolets and whatever else it is they have over there. It's all very exciting.

Can I help? Yes. I've already solved my own country's politics , now it's time to help the benighted and backward people of places like "Connecticut" and "the Oklahoma Panhandle"—fantasy names from a land beyond knowing. People love it when foreigners tell them how to do their own domestic politics, and especially when they have as robust a methodology as I have: a copy of Crusader Kings 3 and most of the DLC.

Using Paradox's premier 1066 simulator, I will ascertain the best way to remove a burrowed-in leader from power. Which real-life figure is this a videogame analogue for? Don't worry about it, don't email me about it, and don't launch a cruise missile at my house.
Don't email me about how the midterms don't choose the president either. I don't know what those words mean.
King of New York
I first had to create an accurate, 11th-century simulacrum of an American president. None of CK3's historical rulers quite fit the bill, so I decided to create a ruler from scratch.
I created an 80-year-old lecher named Wenzel and put him in charge of the Holy Roman Empire. His defining trait was 'lunatic'.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/gKhxvqCS9P6t4odb68vJ2g-1920-80.jpg

So that was sorted. Next, I needed a position from which to actually act in the world. I needed to be someone who could effect change in the HRE and test my theories as to the best way to go about removing a leader. This was easier: I simply nosed through Wenzel's myriad direct vassals and picked one who seemed most like some guy , thus to represent the working masses of the American Empire. I've quite genuinely forgotten his name, but he had very few traits and was prone to tuberculosis.
I've quite genuinely forgotten his name, but he had very few traits and was prone to tuberculosis.

We were off to the races. I immediately cast about to find some means of dislodging the boss. My first solution was simple: plunge the realm in an internecine civil war that scourges the land with blood and fire. Unfortunately, I soon realised I probably wouldn't be allowed to suggest that as an option for the American people in an international videogames publication, so I decided to, like, win an election or something instead. Whatever.

Well, okay, not just win an election. The bloodless paths to power I saw were to either get myself nominated as the old man's heir (HRE elections aren't as regular as modern-day America's—at the time of writing—and so I couldn't replace him directly via one) or to butter him up so nicely that he declares me co-ruler.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/dXrSkpTktrDob3jTjYepE3-1920-80.jpg

I opted for both. My first move was to ply my delicate kaiser with flattery and gifts. He liked flattery and gifts, and as a bonus, by showering him with them I significantly decreased the odds I would wake up to find all my lands redistributed among his wretched children. I increased the odds I would wake up at all, at that.

With my other hand, I penned fawning letters to his most powerful vassals: 'My esteemed lord, my honourable lady, your most munificent worshipfulness…' On and on I went, doling out what little gifts were available to me, and starting schemes to sway and cajole the realm's most powerful. It all seemed, almost boringly, to be coming together. Perhaps the great secret to overcoming your political enemies is… just being plain old nice?
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/bXkedH2SdeffKbbfUXYvpE-1920-80.jpg

No. Absolutely not. Being nice is just the vague flouncing about you do before you get serious and start organising the guillotines. Though I had successfully gotten a fair few influential figures on-side, none of them seemed inclined to support me for the big chair. As for Wenzel? He was fond of me, but he was also ancient and deranged, and was apparently too busy getting deep into religious superstition (quite literally, he acquired the 'superstition' modifier while I wasn't looking, somehow) to dedicate much thought to power sharing.
Time to get serious.
Not time to get serious

Somehow this goddamn idiot caused a plague. I don't know how, I don't know why, I don't know if what I am describing is even really possible within the mechanics of Crusader Kings 3, but our awful pervert king caused a plague and proceeded to ravage my counties with it. This is what happened regardless as to whether it's possible or not.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/zJaLQMgTBPNDRYSgjYLifL-1920-80.jpg

It was called "Wenzel's Cough" and it quickly tore through most of my subjects (eh) and my entire family (uh oh). My wife had it, my daughters had it, my sons had it, I had it. The whole castle probably looked like a boss arena from Hunt: Showdown—walls caked in viscous emissions and baking like an orchid hothouse.

The busywork of not dying distracted me from the quest to depose Wenzel. I isolated the capital and secured a personal physician, whom I oriented in the general direction of my family and said "Just go nuts chief." He locked me in a room with a trillion bees (this actually happened), which somehow gave major relief to my consumption. I lost the ominous 'Dying' warning at the top of the screen and was free to return to politics. Most of my family got relief too, save one son who died. Fortunately, it was one I was mostly unaware of up to that point.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/tMSdpBFhNKYcKCZbKvye3S-1920-80.jpg

With my attempts at diplomacy foiled, I figured it was time to try war. Wenzel had about 7,000 men in his army whereas I had 1,400. Defeating him on the battlefield would need allies. I began a scheme to sway one of his most powerful vassals: a Tuscan duchess named Matilda with a decent army. Perhaps I could marry her? My current wife was an obstacle, true, but an obstacle with a boutique variant of tuberculosis, so it might all work itself out.
At some point while all this was happening, Wenzel developed the traits "Irritable" and "Withering mind."
And then this idiot duchess went and declared a war of independence against Wenzel without me, practically guaranteeing her defeat, imprisonment, and possible execution.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/uaRJt5PvRJZCF4Aqs9wPxa-1920-80.jpg

What's the real-life lesson here? You can't rely on the tender feelings of powerful people to hand you your salvation in dark political times. They have their own stupid ends and will pursue them to your detriment.

You also can't rely on your loved ones to die from plague at times that are convenient to you, so my plan might not have worked even if Matilda hadn't gone war-mode. Sometime after our Tuscan duchess declared war, Wenzel's cough abated in my lands. The city gates swung open again, and the cloud of death lifted from over my realm.

Except for me, of course. Despite my physician's daring bee treatment, my condition had worsened to the point that the 'Dying' notification was back. Even more galling: I kept proccing events that showed every individual member of my family recovering fully from the disease, one by one. "The sound of laughter echoes in your halls again," beamed CK3, as a new notification asked if I wanted to have my last rites performed or if I wanted to go to hell.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/neQGXL6jB6eHZG6M9HjYBg-1920-80.jpg

Idiot Matilda lost her war around the time I choked out my last on my deathbed, surrounded by my family who were all absolutely fine. In the imperial capital, Wenzel tottered along, muttering to himself as he roamed cavernous palatial spaces. He had new traits: high blood pressure and a faulty heart, but refused to die. A new plague was working its way north through the world towards him. He refused to die. An exploding heart, deranged mind, and multiple competing plagues, and he refused to die.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/752r9YteNcyAoiNmhyrNLW-1920-80.jpg

news.title: 令人惊讶的是，海岸奇才今年第二次“不打算自愿承认”工会的努力
news.summary: "Wizards is not neutral on the question of unionization."

content.v: Per the United Wizards of the Coast Union (UWOTC-CWA) account on X, WoTC is acting in an entirely unsurprising manner: "Yesterday, Wizards informed us that it doesn’t intend to voluntarily recognize the D&D or Studio X units of our union ahead of a vote. We remain committed to creating a workplace focused on wellness, transparency, and collaboration by winning our coming election."
A union composed of employees from the Magic: The Gathering Arena team unionised back in June of this year , giving WoTC until May to formally recognise it. Obviously, it didn't.

Later in the same month, WoTC sent physical letters to members of the company encouraging them not to go through with it on the vote—and while WoTC did technically adhere to the The National Labor Relations Act, it did also not-so-subtly imply that its current benefits would be "on the bargaining table for both parties to negotiate". These letters were also allegedly accompanied by daily emails to employees.

Basically, it should not come as a surprise that Wizards isn't intending to recognize the full United Wizards of the Coast Union—a coalition now formed of members in both the D&D team and Studio X (Magic: The Gathering's creative staff)—either.

In a statement sent to Wargamer , and circulated to employees before that, WoTC stated it was not a fan in the ways it is legally allowed to do so. That being, lots of circular talk about how everyone has the right to unionise:

"We are best able to keep building great games and a great place to work by working directly with employees, not through unions. In this regard, Wizards is not neutral on the question of unionization … in the end, we will respect the results of the election, no matter what our employees choose."

UWOTC-CWA is bargaining for "fair wages, career progression, and job security," as well as remote work protections and "sustainable workloads: We have been asked to do more work with less regard for our personal lives." Other concerns like healthcare, AI protections, and the ability to have legal ownership of creative work made outside of their jobs for WoTC.

As Wargamer itself is right to point out, UWOTC-CWA does have a strong lever to pull. Namely, that D&D and Magic: The Gathering are incredibly profitable. This earnings report shows that "Wizards of the Coast and Digital Gaming" raked in $568 million in operating profit over the past six months (before adjustments), while consumer products lost $62 million, and entertainment dragged just $23 million through the door.

In other words, if you're making most of your company's profit, you're in a prime position to negotiate with them. Unless your corporation decides to lay off 1,000 people, including those responsible for your biggest commercial success, again .

news.title: 讨论时间：您认为 MMO 中的区域聊天是正义的力量还是邪恶的力量？
news.summary: What's up, Barrens Chat.

content.v: https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/PgGhmt5pTtxusaQQX3dHPF-1920-80.png

This is Terminally Online : PC Gamer's very own MMO column. Every other week, I'll be sharing my thoughts on the genre, interviewing fellow MMO-heads like me, taking a deep-dive into mechanics we've all taken for granted, and, occasionally, bringing in guest writers to talk about their MMO of choice.

Ah, zone chats in MMOs—trade and general chats, /shouts and /yells. Intended as a way to render the social glue that binds these videogames together, they are often instead a tableau for (and I say this somewhat affectionately) absolute lunacy, pock-marked with some of the most vile verbiage you'll see online.

Take, for instance, the time-honoured tradition of "Barrens Chat" in World of Warcraft. Combine a big zone that spans around 10-15 levels along with proximity to a major city, and you get a certain kind of verbal hooliganry that, in my journeys through WoW: Forever, I was actually pretty nostalgic for.

I mean, sure, the Chuck Norris jokes have gotten a smidge old. But while collecting Zhevra Hoofs, I would find myself possessed to ask Barrens Chat philosophical questions, and while I never received much in the way of wisdom, responses were always entertaining.

I'm not so fond of trade chat, though, which—at least on the horde side of things—has mostly been dominated by a bot by the name of Margrave Tyrael . Who, I kid you not, was literally sitting there for days spitting out the same automated messages, questioning why Blizzard was deleting beta characters.
I fell for it, at first. Then I started trying to warn people not to fall for it. It didn't work.

Things are no less cursed in my other MMO of choice, Final Fantasy 14. I shan't repeat some of the obscenity I've seen in Ul'dah here, but it does always stagger me that the same kind of infectious absurdity can persist, particularly in a videogame whose moderators are altogether far more heavy-handed with banning folks for ill behaviour.
Which leads me to my question, dear reader: Zone chats. Are they a force for good, or ill?

Personally, I'm weirdly fond of them. I don't think these chats are particularly healthy to engage with, and they're certainly not worth arguing with some rando over. But the belligerent nonsense of the masses feels somehow pure. Unsullied by the algorithmic mechanisms that drive us, purposefully, towards enragement and bickering. Instead, we piss people off all by ourselves. And that's kind of beautiful.

news.title: 这款关于研磨无声的无形肉块的游戏让我意识到我已经被资本主义迷惑了
news.summary: Flesh grinders of the world, unite.

content.v: Weird Weekend is our regular Saturday column where we celebrate PC gaming oddities: peculiar games, strange bits of trivia, forgotten history. Pop back every weekend to find out what Jeremy, Josh and Rick have become obsessed with this time, whether it's the canon height of Thief's Garrett or that time someone in the Vatican pirated Football Manager .
I am a stakhanovite, a hero-worker. My productivity is not measured in grams but kilos. My working hours have been divided and subdivided into ultimate efficiency: not a nanosecond is wasted.

That is, in Flesh Grinding , whose demo I've been mucking about with. Not in real life, where my working hours consist mostly of staring at a blank Google Doc and wondering if I'm a moron who could never actually write at all.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/QjoVNc5KFoDckdN5u3Z9A8-1920-80.jpg

Anyway, Flesh Grinding, which releases in Q4 2026—not to be confused with Fleshgrinder , which releases in Q1 2027; good luck—is a labour simulator. It's also one of those PS1-style horror games that are so fashionable right now. But mostly it is a game about working.

Working, specifically, with flesh—great, distended chunks of the stuff that plop down from the ceiling and amass in shiny piles. You must pick them up, walk them to your grinder, then turn them to mince. You must do this until your IV drip runs out of fluid, at which point it is time to return to your home and upgrade yourself, spending the millilitres of blood you scrounged from your grinding on upgrades.

Hit your goal (a kilo of meat at first, then five kilos, and so on) and new areas open up with new machines—feed a lump of flesh to this thing and it will spit out IV-replenishing potions, that kind of thing, which add entirely new aspects of the fundamental flesh-grinding loop to think about and strategise for.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/KJx66f7tDP4hf9CfEjKc48-1920-80.jpg

You're no longer just trying to run as quickly as possible between your flesh pile and your grinders. Now you have to figure out when in the process to stop at the new machines, how to run a perfect loop that wastes the absolute minimum amount of time you get each day on the factory floor.
In this way, it is exactly like real life.

No, really. Or, well, sort of really. I've definitely worked jobs that felt as grey and arduous as standing at Flesh Grinding's, uh, flesh grinder and attempting to maximise the return of each stifling second—to cram as much compensable work into every fragment of time I had before the inevitable burnout set in. It wasn't quite an IV drip of unknowable motivating fluid or an endless parade of shapeless flesh: it was writing freelance marketing copy, which was worse.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/2wyoP9sxeiiGXnjZnyREH8-1920-80.jpg

I'm rather impressed by Flesh Grinding for condensing this experience down into its sickly gameplay loop. It's a laborious work sim that nonetheless feels quite moreish, that tempts you to return day after day to make some new tweak to your routine or to test out a new machine.

That's what's really horrifying, I say. I mean, sure, the blood and strange ethereal figures and creepy grandmother and ever-multiplying religious icons are also, probably, scary to someone, but surely far less than the constant reminder that the trade you make for being alive is selling eight hours (at least) of your day, every day, to distant and unknowable forces, and all the wear on your body and mind that entails. And then you spend your off hours trying to compute how to come in the next day and do it all even more efficiently . What a horrible scam we've played on ourselves. What a, um, grind.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/6offQUY4CXebir2TC27dMd-1920-80.jpg

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/16/ss-6b8f4040a1e923f036e04d9eb21ecb0f866be57e-1920x1080-1792164596496.jpg
Barry Sloane, the actor behind Call of Duty's Captain Price, has shared a message with fans as praise for Modern Warfare 4's campaign rolls in.

Early reactions to Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4's story mode have filled social media feeds in the first 24 hours since early access players dived in – and most of them seem to be quite positive. Fans online have called it one of the more "brutal" and "intense" campaigns the series has ever seen, with many going as far as to say it holds its own against classic stories featured in games like the original Modern Warfare 2 and Black Ops.

It appears to be a winner for publisher Activision and developer Infinity Ward that critics like, too. While Steam reviews paint a "Very Positive" picture, IGN awarded this year's set of story missions an 8/10 . Our reviewer said the Modern Warfare 4 campaign made them "feel something for the series again," adding that it managed to send the reboot saga series out "on a high note."
"The MW4 campaign was a 10/10 for me, they made a good story and ended it," one recent Steam review said . "Damn near almost cried at the end LOL."

As reviews continue to trickle in, many have taken the time to praise Sloane's work as Captain Price, specifically. The star behind Activision's most recent incarnation of the Task Force 141 leader took to social media to respond to the "kind words" he's received.
"Thank you for all the kind words," he said. "I see them. I read them. And I am grateful."

As Infinity Ward sought to end this Modern Warfare storyline with the 2026 Call of Duty game, it should come as no surprise to see that the developers took big swings in its story. With that said, full-on, untagged Modern Warfare 4 campaign spoilers have already started to show up across feeds, too. There's not much Activision can do about that, but Sloane used his message as an opportunity to ask fans to keep unfiltered reactions to themselves, at least for now.
"Remember," he continued, "let's allow people to enjoy the game in their own time. No spoilers. Bravo 6 – Dark."

Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4's campaign is out now for early access players. Its DMZ mode will drop Tuesday, October 20, with the full release set to follow Friday, October 23, for PC, Nintendo Switch 2, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X/S. For a full debrief on the events of the FPS franchise's latest story mode, click here . You can also check out the full breakdown of release times here .

news.title: Ghostwire：东京加入 GOG 保护计划，这意味着您不必再与 Bethesda.NET 打交道
news.summary: …if you get it on GOG, anyway.

content.v: Ghostwire: Tokyo, Tango Gameworks' spooky, neon-drenched action-adventure game, is now officially a good old game. Granted, it's not that old, but 'good' seems about right given that contributing writer Imogen Mellor scored it a 72 in her review . But what I mean is that it's joined GOG's Preservation Program .

If you're wondering why a game from 2022 would need to be preserved already, well, it kind of doesn't. You may be thinking the game is finally free from its seemingly arbitrary implementation of Denuvo , but that was actually removed shortly after it was added . What this release does is remove Bethesda.NET integration (providing any extra goodies on your first launch of the game) and come with a promise from GOG that any stability issues that arise as decades pass and operating systems change will be addressed in future patches.

That may just come into play given that Tango Gameworks would be closed right now if Xbox's sudden closure of the studio hadn't been canceled out with an acquisition by PUBG owner Krafton . It's worth noting that the game still appears to be published by Bethesda Softworks, so if you're trying to avoid Microsoft products for any genocide-related reasons , you'll have to weigh that as a consideration.

As for Ghostwire itself, it proved surprisingly popular with over 6 million players . We called it a great game that Elden Ring overshadowed around release alongside the quietly adored Teardown and Sifu. Like its left-field follow-up Hi-Fi Rush, Ghostwire seemed to hit pretty hard for the cult it attracted. Hopefully Tango can capture some of that juice in the games it's currently developing under Krafton .

content.v: 由你来说： 纽约同一面墙，13年前画着前作封面女郎，如今换成了《GTA6》的杰森和露西娅。你觉得《GTA6》的宣传美术更有魅力，还是《给他爱5》的经典封面更让你难忘？
近日，一位网友在Reddit论坛分享了两张对比照片，记录了纽约同一面墙壁上的变化：2013年，这里曾绘有《给他爱5》的宣传壁画；如今，墙面已经换上了《GTA6》的全新手绘作品。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/10/small_202610101626146186.webp
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/10/small_202610101626159251.webp
新壁画以主角杰森和露西娅为中心，搭配棕榈树与充满都市气息的夜景，整体风格呼应了游戏中的罪城（Vice City）。而13年前的旧壁画则采用了《给他爱5》标志性的封面女郎形象。

“这也太离谱了，13年就这么过去了！我到现在还是觉得难以置信。”
“我说不清具体原因，但我真的很喜欢《GTA6》的美术作品。《GTA》系列每一部的美术风格都有自己的特色，但《GTA6》的作品就是特别对我的胃口。每次看到新的宣传图，我都忍不住想下载下来。”
“太美了！”

news.title: 国产性感新游销量暴增吓坏团队！给玩家磕头:别买了
news.summary: 曾开发《墨境》的国产游戏团队犁浦工作室宣布，旗下新作《太吾异世劫》于10月15日开启抢先体验（EA）后，仅用12小时销量便突破1.5万…

content.v: https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/17/small_202610171413518596.png
曾开发《墨境》的国产游戏团队犁浦工作室宣布，旗下新作《太吾异世劫》于10月15日开启抢先体验（EA）后，仅用12小时销量便突破1.5万份。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/17/small_202610171420015777.png
对于这一成绩，工作室表示，销量远超团队预期，但当前版本仍存在优化、引导、数值平衡、Bug等问题，内容量也不够充足，认为游戏目前的体验还配不上玩家的信任。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/17/small_202610171420102704.png
犁浦工作室坦言，不会以“仍处于EA阶段”为理由回避问题。团队已经开始高强度收集玩家反馈，并将严重崩溃、卡死、存档异常等问题列为最高优先级，其他问题则根据影响范围安排修复。工作室承诺及时推出修复更新，并定期公开修复进度与后续开发路线图。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/17/small_202610171420214485.png
值得注意的是，工作室甚至在公告中主动建议尚未购买的玩家暂时不要入手，只需将游戏加入愿望单，等后续更新几个版本、观察评价后再决定是否购买。对于已经购买的玩家，团队则为当前版本体验不佳致歉，并呼吁大家积极反馈遇到的问题。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/17/small_202610171414501069.png
公告最后，犁浦工作室表示不会跑路、不会装死，也不会空口承诺，而是会持续同步开发进度、修复问题并更新内容。团队感谢玩家的支持，并恳请大家给予一些时间。
对于一款刚刚开启EA、销量又超出预期的国产游戏而言，开发团队主动劝玩家暂缓购买的表态颇为少见。接下来，团队能否通过持续更新兑现承诺，将成为玩家关注的重点。

news.title: 职业选手浑身虫子咬痕！惨被禁止参赛 怕传播臭虫
news.summary: 据Dexerto报道，《任天堂明星大乱斗》传奇选手Mew2King（Jason Zimmerman）已经被德州Xtreme Fighters Showdown（XFS）赛事禁止参与…

content.v: 据Dexerto报道，《任天堂明星大乱斗》传奇选手Mew2King（Jason Zimmerman）已经被德州Xtreme Fighters Showdown（XFS）赛事禁止参与本次线下活动，整件事源自选手社交媒体上分享的居家虫咬困扰，在社区引发巨大讨论。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/17/small_202610171530467165.png
本次XFS大赛于10月16‑17日举办，同时开设Melee与Ultimate项目。就在动身飞往德州之前，Mew2King在社交平台发帖求助，展示自己红肿发胀的双手，怀疑是高强度练拳或者家中虫子叮咬所致。他透露家中虫扰问题已经持续数月，身上每周都会出现大量咬痕，这也是他计划搬家的重要原因，不过他本人也无法完全确定到底是跳蚤还是床虱。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/17/small_202610171530555977.png
帖子发出之后，大乱斗社区的担忧迅速发酵。不少玩家担心床虱会依附衣物、行李箱四处扩散，坐飞机、去线下大型赛事，有可能把虫害传播给现场大量参赛者与观众。CDC公开资料也提到，床虫会通过个人随身物品完成传播，和个人卫生好坏没有必然联系，值得注意的是，并没有实锤证明 Mew2King身上已经携带床虱。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/17/small_202610171531059308.png
出于全体到场人员的健康安全考量，XFS官方最终做出决定，不允许Mew2King参与本届赛事。官方表态称，所有参赛者的健康与体验是赛事的第一优先级。
这件事也让玩家重新聊起线下格斗赛的卫生话题。此前格斗游戏圈已经出现过多起相关风波，曾有选手抱怨对手身上气味影响比赛发挥，类似事件一直在社区存在不小争议。

news.title: 《恶意不息》正式版新内容官宣！体量翻倍 PS5版优化
news.summary: 据Gematsu报道，Moon Studios在最新一期“Wicked Inside”开发者展示节目中，公开了类魂ARPG《恶意不息》1.0版本的大量新情报。

content.v: 据Gematsu报道，Moon Studios在最新一期“Wicked Inside”开发者展示节目中，公开了类魂ARPG《恶意不息》1.0版本的大量新情报。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/17/small_202610171028015487.png
1.0版本会将游戏整体体量几乎扩充一倍，加入全新区域、敌人、BOSS，同时优化战利品系统、战斗手感与游戏体验，也会针对PS5版本进行性能打磨。本作1.0将于2027年3月登陆PC与PS5，Xbox Series、Switch2版本会在之后陆续推出，目前游戏仍处于PC抢先体验阶段。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/17/small_202610171028095767.png
新版本彻底砍掉旧的属性加点体系，带来全新职业机制：更换武器即可切换职业，合计24个职业，拥有362种特质，还能跨职业继承能力，自由组合打出雷霆万钧、潜行暗杀等多样战斗流派。

游戏还加入六大派系，例如断手刺客团、圣礼城守卫等。玩家可以一步步提升在派系中的地位，解锁专属任务线、特质与特殊商人。另外“塞利姆核心”这套生存养成系统也正式亮相，它可以提升血量、耐力、攻速、吸血等属性，但如果超载，角色受到的伤害也会大幅增加，充满风险抉择。

news.title: iPhoneDuo黄牛价格暴跌！溢价从5.8万跌至3000元
news.summary: iPhone Duo预售瞬间售罄，黄牛从溢价5.8万元跌到只加价3000元，官方发货排至明年1月。

content.v: 10月16日，苹果首款折叠屏iPhone Duo开启预售，开售瞬间官网和电商平台被挤爆，首批货源迅速售罄。该机仅支持eSIM，没有Face ID，也没有长焦镜头。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/17/small_202610172211475003.jpg
早在一个月前，得物平台上的预售订单就已开始报价。9月11日，定价21499元的1TB版本一度报至79999元，溢价超过5.8万元。如今多位黄牛在二手交易平台上只加价3000元，还承诺首销当天就能拿货。从近6万元的溢价到3000元，价格回落幅度明显。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/17/small_202610172209171412.jpg
尽管黄牛报价大幅回落，仍有网友建议消费者没必要从黄牛手里拿货。当前溢价只是短期供需失衡造成的，随着产线良率稳步提升，iPhone Duo产能将持续爬坡，一两个月后预计货源充足，价格也有望进一步回归理性。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/17/small_202610172209422924.jpg
有观望者说得很直白：现在加价三五千，等于给黄牛打工。对于没有Face ID和长焦镜头的初代折叠屏，耐心等待官方供货更划算。目前官方渠道仍可正常排队预订，只是发货延后，iPhone Duo发货时间已排至明年1月，起售价15999元。多等一段时间，就能省下数千元溢价，还能享受完整官方保修。

news.title: Sweet Baby彻底凉凉！游戏厂商终于不用搞DEI了？
news.summary: 长期为游戏行业提供叙事与多元化咨询的Sweet Baby Inc.近期出现大规模裁员缩编

content.v: 编辑观点： 据外媒报道，长期为游戏行业提供叙事与多元化咨询的Sweet Baby Inc.近期出现大规模裁员缩编，公司规模大幅收缩，多个合作项目被曝终止或不再续约。 厂商已经看到绑定Sweet Baby会带来舆论风险，会更加谨慎地对待外部价值观咨询，拒绝生硬的标签式修改。市场用商业结果证明：玩家反感不顾剧情硬塞身份要素，资本会调整方向，优先把游玩和故事质量放在第一位。玩家的市场反馈会倒逼行业，未来多元内容或许会更注重融入剧情，减少脱离叙事的强行植入。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/17/small_202610171351434561.png
Sweet Baby只是众多DEI咨询机构中的一个符号，大厂内部本身就设有多元包容审核岗位，就算外部公司没订单，内部流程依然存在。全球市场用户构成持续变化，多元角色叙事依旧是全球化商业游戏的现实需要，需求不会因为一家公司收缩就消失。玩家反感的是部分机构激进的工作方式，不等于全盘否定游戏内的多元化人物，相关创作需求会换别的形式继续存在。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/17/small_202610171351585161.png
Sweet Baby曾参与《心灵杀手2》《战神：诸神黄昏》等作品的咨询工作，2024年因反DEI运动成为舆论焦点，被部分玩家视为“强行植入政治正确”的代表符号。此次收缩被不少玩家解读为“DEI退潮”的信号，但也有分析指出，这更多是一家外部咨询公司在舆论压力和商业风险下的个体收缩，而非整个行业多元化需求的消失。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/17/small_202610171355158194.png

一部分玩家认为这是“玩家的胜利”，直言“市场终于让厂商知道硬塞标签会付出代价”；另一部分人则保持冷静，指出“Sweet Baby只是一个符号，大厂内部的DEI审核岗位还在，流程不会因为一家公司裁员就消失”；还有人认为，反DEI运动本身也出现了过度扩大化的倾向，“反对强行植入没问题，但把所有多元角色都打成DEI就变味了”。整体来看，玩家普遍乐见厂商减少生硬的价值输出，但也清楚这并不等于行业多元化叙事的终结。
你认为Sweet Baby收缩意味着游戏行业DEI退潮，还是只是换了一种形式继续存在？评论区聊聊。

news.title: 《街头霸王》电影嘉米太放荡 调戏春丽被批乱改！
news.summary: 据外媒Kotaku报道，《街头霸王》真人电影对嘉米的角色塑造引发了部分系列粉丝的不满。Kotaku认为，电影中的嘉米与游戏原作形象相去…

content.v: 据外媒Kotaku报道，《街头霸王》真人电影对嘉米的角色塑造引发了部分系列粉丝的不满。Kotaku认为，电影中的嘉米与游戏原作形象相去甚远，不仅性格大变，还被塑造成了一个带有小丑女哈莉·奎茵风格的角色。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/17/small_202610171503593874.png
Kotaku指出，尽管这部《街头霸王》真人电影本身就带有夸张、荒诞的风格，很难完全按照游戏原作的标准来要求其角色塑造，但嘉米的改编仍然让不少粉丝难以接受。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/17/small_202610171504465481.png
在《街头霸王》系列中，嘉米原本是被洗脑并控制的战士，曾是反派维加麾下的“人偶”之一，和其他年轻女性受到组织的精神控制，随着剧情发展，嘉米试图摆脱对方的控制，重新掌握自己的人生。不过，在真人电影中，嘉米仍然处于维加的控制之下，并担任他的得力助手。Kotaku认为，粉丝真正不满的并不是这一设定，而是电影将原本冷静、寡言、纪律严明的女战士，改造成了一个行为放荡、喜欢调情且情绪起伏剧烈的角色。
https://imggif.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/17/origin_202610171504258376.gif
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/17/small_202610171509188536.png
电影中的嘉米由梅尔·贾恩森（Mel Jarnson）饰演，执行命令时，她依旧显得干练强势，能够掌控场面，但与此同时，她又表现出异常强烈的魅惑倾向，甚至曾主动调戏春丽。此外，她还会突然情绪失控、大声尖叫。
Kotaku认为，这种塑造让嘉米看起来更像是另一名《街头霸王》角色——韩蛛俐的替代品，后者本身具有更为邪气、疯狂的一面。Kotaku猜测，电影制作团队可能原本希望将韩蛛俐加入故事，却最终没能安排好她的角色，于是，把部分人物特征直接移植到了嘉米身上。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/17/small_202610171504552022.png
报道最后指出，这部电影对整体剧情和其他角色的处理同样相当随意，但嘉米的形象变化尤为明显。对于熟悉游戏原作的粉丝而言，这种改编不仅改变了角色的性格，也让她失去了原本最具辨识度的特质。

news.title: 职业选手被曝假赛后炫富翻车！晒大把现金被终身禁赛
news.summary: 近日，一名《反恐精英2》职业选手在因假赛被禁赛三年期间，于社交媒体晒出大笔现金并发表挑衅言论，结果遭到赛事诚信委员会（ESIC）…

content.v: https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/17/small_202610171008309269.png
近日，一名《反恐精英2》职业选手在因假赛被禁赛三年期间，于社交媒体晒出大笔现金并发表挑衅言论，结果遭到赛事诚信委员会（ESIC）追加处罚，禁赛期限从三年升级为终身，相关行为还将被移交执法部门处理。
这名选手是年仅22岁的Palkovics Tamás游戏ID为“2xplayN”。10月15日，ESIC公布了针对NOMERCY战队五名选手的处罚结果。调查涉及该战队在Roman Imperium Cup VII期间的可疑比赛，以及一笔潜在奖金超过450万美元的投注。最初，playN被处以三年禁赛，禁止其参加ESIC及其成员组织旗下的赛事，禁赛期限持续至2029年4月。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/17/small_202610171008372087.png
然而，处罚公布后不久，playN便在X平台发布了一张照片，展示自己手持数叠厚厚的现金。他还配文写道：“2029年，我们Roman Imperium Cup再见。”并附上了一个大笑表情。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/17/small_202610171008386302.png
10月16日，也就是最初处罚公布的第二天，ESIC宣布将playN的禁赛处罚升级为终身禁赛。委员会表示，作出这一决定的原因是该选手随后发布了一系列公开内容，其中包括疑似现金的照片，以及涉及比赛操纵、下注奖金和未来复出的言论。ESIC认为，这些行为构成了“严重违规，造成了不当行为的表象”，违反了委员会的相关规定。
此外，ESIC透露，委员会计划将相关行为移交给Valve、政府机构及执法部门处理。
此次事件最初源于对NOMERCY战队的假赛调查。调查重点涉及该战队在2026年3月遭遇的四场失利。ESIC发现，这些比赛结果均符合一笔可疑组合投注的条件，而该笔投注的潜在回报超过450万美元。

news.title: 国产性感新作官宣大型更新计划！黑丝美乳 包玩爽
news.summary: 《太吾异世劫》公布2026年首期更新内容规划，重点包括多人游玩难度与掉率调整、战斗及性能优化，以及计划于11月推出的五阶装备、装…

content.v: 国产游戏《太吾异世劫》公布2026年首期更新内容规划，重点包括多人游玩难度与掉率调整、战斗及性能优化，以及计划于11月推出的五阶装备、装备合成系统和表情轮盘自定义功能。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/17/small_202610171427413947.png
官方表示，后续还将持续增加地图、Boss、技能、装备与角色等内容。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/17/small_202610171427505905.png
首期更新将重点修复游戏问题并调整平衡性。 官方计划调整多人游玩模式下的难度平衡和掉率，优化功法范围与效果、绝品装备效果，并优化加载卡顿、游戏帧数及UI视觉效果。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/17/small_202610171428116680.png
11月更新将新增多项装备与自定义功能。 根据路线图，游戏计划新增第五阶装备“神品”，并加入装备合成系统，玩家可以消耗低等级装备，合成一件更高等级装备。同时，游戏还将新增表情轮盘自定义系统。
至于后续更新，官方列出了更多内容方向，包括：
- 更多地图与Boss；
- 更多技能与装备；
- 更多角色与灵侍；
- 增加“窟渠之民”的战斗协同功能；
- 自定义螺舟外观与内饰；
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/17/small_202610171429198716.png
- 更多游玩模式，以及不同地图的难度等级。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/17/small_202610171429353329.png
官方表示，EA版本上线后收到了大量玩家反馈，并根据这些意见调整了原有更新计划的优先级。完整内容规划与路线图预计将于10月底公布，届时团队计划加快内容更新节奏。
需要注意的是，目前公布的内容属于初步规划，实际更新安排仍可能根据玩家反馈进行调整。

news.title: 超千位玩家投票！《鬼武者》获"PS5九月最佳游戏"
news.summary: 近日，游戏媒体 Push Square 公布了2026年9月PS5平台月度最佳游戏投票结果，卡普空新作《鬼武者：剑之道》以微弱优势击败《漫威金刚…

content.v: 由你来说： 2026年九月或将被玩家们铭记，鬼武者、金刚狼、控制、共轨、火纹等大作齐出，最合你胃口的游戏是哪款？
近日，游戏媒体 Push Square 公布了2026年9月PS5平台月度最佳游戏投票结果，卡普空新作《鬼武者：剑之道》以微弱优势击败《漫威金刚狼》，成功夺冠。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/17/small_202610172206002692.png

https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/17/small_202610172205243111.png
9月PS5游戏投票前五名如下：
4. 《黎明行者之血》：138票，占10%
5. 《空之轨迹 the 2nd》：133票，占10%
Push Square认为，《鬼武者：剑之道》能够获胜并不令人意外。卡普空近年来在动作游戏领域表现出色，而本作也是PS5平台上颇为突出的动作游戏之一。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/17/small_202610172206558595.png
媒体尤其称赞了游戏围绕弹反与反击打造的战斗系统，以及表现力出色的动作动画。此前，Push Square在游戏评测中将其称为“武士动作游戏的典范”，并给出了9/10的优秀评价。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/17/small_202610172207116878.png
值得一提的是，这也是卡普空在2026年第三次获得Push Square月度最佳游戏奖项，进一步体现了该公司今年在游戏市场上的强劲表现。

news.title: 华裔春丽自曝压力巨大！为还原肉腿暴吃鸡蛋猛训练
news.summary: 据IGN报道，在《街头霸王》电影中饰演春丽的演员卡莉娜·梁近日透露，自己在得知出演消息引发玩家讨论后，曾感受到巨大压力。

content.v: 据IGN报道，在《街头霸王》电影中饰演春丽的演员卡莉娜·梁近日透露，自己在得知出演消息引发玩家讨论后，曾感受到巨大压力。

尤其是看到 Reddit 上有玩家质疑她的大腿不够粗壮、与游戏中的春丽形象存在差距时，她意识到自己必须更加努力地为角色做准备。
卡莉娜·梁在接受Project Big Screen采访时表示，自己本身也是《街头霸王》的粉丝，能够理解玩家希望演员尽可能还原游戏角色形象的心情。她坦言，游戏中的春丽身材非常夸张，自己也希望能够达到粉丝的期待。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/17/small_202610171532248956.png
不过，由于她只有两个月的时间为角色做准备，因此必须在身体训练和实际拍摄需求之间找到平衡。卡莉娜·梁表示，自己的目标是尽最大努力，不给自己留下遗憾，同时也要确保最终能够正常完成表演。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/17/small_202610171532345028.png
为了增强腿部肌肉，卡莉娜·梁进行了大量训练，包括跆拳道、泰拳和武术，每天训练约两小时。饮食方面，她在增肌期间每天要吃12个鸡蛋，每隔两小时进食一次，甚至一度吃到想吐。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/17/small_202610171532428972.png
她透露，这些努力最终取得了效果，拍摄结束时，她的两侧大腿围分别增加了6.5厘米。由于她的身材变化明显，就连替身演员也难以完全还原相同的体型，不得不借助臀部填充垫来达到更接近的视觉效果。
卡莉娜·梁表示，面对外界的质疑，她始终坚持尽全力准备角色。虽然无法在短时间内完全达到游戏中的夸张身材，但她对自己的努力感到满意。

news.title: 《COD23》战役夯爆！今日游民最热新闻大汇总
动视高管吐槽玩家"忽视"COD 我们做游戏也不容易啊
news.summary: 巴尔称评测与口碑上的额外审视是“使命召唤税”，并称系列有1亿免费玩家、5亿销量。

content.v: 《使命召唤23：现代战争4》是经典FPS《使命召唤》系列的最新作，由Infinity Ward制作，Activision发行，即将于2026年10月23日正式在PC/PS5/Switch2/XSX平台发售。
据 TheGameBusiness 报道，此前有知名游戏记者在一次与该媒体的圆桌会议上表示，自己已不像过去那样频繁报道这一系列，该系列的大量内容如今来自网红与创作者圈子。而近日，动视首席营销官泰勒·巴尔在最近在接受采访时回应了《使命召唤》媒体关注度的问题。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/new/content/2026/10/16/cas_auto/small_0_4926898.jpg
巴尔没有否认报道量的变化，他给出的说法是“我们得到了报道”，但把评测和反响环节面临的那部分额外压力称为“使命召唤税”。在他看来，独立游戏周围有大量粉丝，Steam 上每天冒出的新作也自带热度，而《使命召唤》则因为存在的时间太长，人们有时反而会忘记做这些游戏要投入多少工作。
“我们依然获得了媒体报道。但在考虑游戏评测和玩家反响时，我们把这种现象称为‘《使命召唤》税’。显然，独立游戏拥有大量忠实粉丝，而Steam上每天都有新游戏推出，也总能激起玩家的兴奋之情。《使命召唤》则已经存在了很长时间，因此人们有时会忘记，制作这些游戏需要付出多么巨大的努力。我们这里有4500名员工，他们都在努力打造尽可能出色的游戏体验。”
https://img1b.gamersky.com/new/content/2026/10/16/cas_auto/small_0_4926925.jpg
简单来说，《使命召唤》仍是动视投入最重的产品线之一，但如今已经很难再靠“新作上线”本身换来过去那种讨论量。巴尔提到，动视有 4500 名员工在打磨这一体验，今年也希望借营销把团队的投入展示出来。
他认为，《使命召唤》过于庞大的受众有时会被忽视，甚至被当成理所当然的常态。他把当前营销的目标之一定为让外界重新看到游戏背后的工艺与团队投入。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/new/content/2026/10/16/cas_auto/small_0_4927008.jpg
他表示：“我们的免费游玩玩家有1亿人，游戏累计销量达到5亿份。我们是有史以来规模最大的游戏系列之一，而且手游下载量已达10亿次。我认为，这样庞大的玩家群体有时反而会被人们忽视，或者被视为理所当然。这些游戏的制作凝聚了大量专业技艺，而开发团队所付出的心血与坚持，也是我们今年希望通过营销活动向外界展现的东西。”

news.title: 生软前制作人警告CDPR：你们危险了
news.summary: BioWare前制作人Mark Darrah近日公开表达了对CD Projekt Red（CDPR）开发路线的担忧

content.v: https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/17/small_202610171037371219.png
BioWare前制作人Mark Darrah近日公开表达了对CD Projekt Red（CDPR）开发路线的担忧。他警告称，CDPR正踏入高风险超大作区间。Darrah估算，CDPR当前推进的作品可能需要卖出1500万至2000万份才能实现盈利，这一门槛远高于多数3A游戏的商业预期。他曾担任《龙腾世纪：起源》联合总监，并参与《圣歌》的执行制作，对大型项目的成本结构并不陌生。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/17/small_202610171037459945.png

在Darrah看来，行业对《GTA6》式超大规模项目的追逐正在挤压其他类型的生存空间。他提出，如果开发商减少对“下一款GTA”的执念，就能为销量达到300万至400万份即可成立的项目留出余地，并以《光与影：33号远征队》作为这类中等规模作品的代表。他本人也明确表示，不愿意参与那种必须卖出5000万份才能避免亏损的项目。换句话说，问题不在于CDPR有没有能力做超大游戏，而在于这种体量的游戏一旦未达预期，容错空间极小。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/17/small_202610171037462976.png
目前CDPR正在同时推进《巫师4》《赛博朋克2》以及代号哈达尔计划的项目，其中哈达尔计划已从世界观构建阶段转入部分原型测试。需要说明的是，Darrah提出的成本与销量门槛属于其个人分析，并非CDPR公开的财务指引，也不代表上述任何项目已有成败结论。对CDPR而言，真正的考验或许不是能否做出更大的游戏，而是能否在规模与风险之间找到可持续的平衡。

news.title: 《使命召唤23》战役GS打出7分 最终决战有点拉
news.summary: GameSpot发布《使命召唤23：现代战争4》战役评测

content.v: GameSpot发布《使命召唤23：现代战争4》战役评测，给出7分（Good）。评测认为，本作没有追求创新，而是回到更传统、更线性的战役结构，依靠扎实的叙事、紧凑的节奏和多样化的任务设计，交出了一份令人满意的收官答卷，也是自2019年《现代战争》重启以来最好的战役。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/17/small_202610170939207558.png
评测肯定了任务多样性：潜行、徒步与载具追逐、慢动作破门、直升机炮手、夜视清房等经典桥段均有出现，且整体节奏没有因多线叙事和多视角切换而松散。可选对话提示得到保留，Boss式近战遭遇虽然不复杂，但为流程增加了张力。唯一的开放世界任务允许玩家直接快速旅行到目标点，跳过探索和收集，评测认为这反而让该设计的存在价值受到质疑，不过也为愿意探索的玩家提供了重玩空间。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/17/small_202610170939331182.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/17/small_202610170939346549.png
缺点方面，评测指出最终“Boss战”令人失望，缺乏挑战且过于短促，但故事收尾仍算令人满意。整体而言，GameSpot认为《现代战争4》证明系列不需要彻底重造轮子，只要叙事扎实、角色可信、任务保持紧迫感，就能做出令人投入的单人体验。

news.title: 《黎明行者之血》的第一个重大更新将添加定向动物抚摸和比之前的故事模式更容易的新故事模式
news.summary: "What happens when you merge a directional combat system with an ability to pet dogs and cats?"

others.title: 《黎明行者之血》的下一个更新将让你消除错误并抚摸狗
《黎明行者之血》更新 1.1 添加了定向动物抚摸以及超过 1,100 项其他改进和修复

content.v: I've nothing against games that feature simulated animal petting, but it's never been something I've considered buying a game specifically for. Sure, it's nice when your character can stroke a virtual dog or fuss with a clump of polygons shaped like a cat, but it rarely amounts to more than a canned animation. That said, I am suddenly more tempted to shell out on The Blood of Dawnwalker , as Rebel Wolves has announced that the next update to its vampire RPG will introduce "directional animal petting".

The Blood of Dawnwalker already features a directional combat system in the vein of Kingdom Come: Deliverance . And this system lies at the heart of the animal petting being added to version 1.1 of the vampire RPG—according to an update the developer posted on X : "What happens when you merge a directional combat system with an ability to pet dogs and cats?" Rebel Wolves asked. "Directional. Animal. Petting."

Sadly, Rebel Wolves didn't provide any further detail about this system. But it did offer plenty of insight into what else is coming with update 1.1. Aside from being able to stroke cats at different angles, perhaps the most significant addition is a new Story mode. This will feature an "additional combat assist" for players who aren't interested in mastering the game's swordplay, letting them focus mainly on enjoying the narrative and making decisions. It's worth noting this will not replace the existing Story mode outright. That difficulty setting will still exist, but under the new name of "Forgiving."

Elsewhere, The Blood of Dawnwalker will now allow players to rework their abilities through the Draught of Mind Rebirth, which gives you back the points you've allocated into the RPG's various skill trees and lets you spend them elsewhere. That's it for major new features, but smaller changes coming in 1.1 include improved combat targeting, better traversal, in-game camera tweaks, and updates to the RPG's FrameGen tech.

In total, Rebel Wolves promise 1100 changes coming to The Blood of Dawnwalker. It's unlikely any of these will relate to the game's controversial time mechanic , even though the studio has said this system might not feature in the sequel . And a sequel to The Blood of Dawnwalker is coming. Rebel Wolves is already working on it after the first game sold 1 million copies in its first three days on sale .

others.title: 分析师估计，《羊蹄之魂》销量落后于《对马》，但 PS5 版销量依然强劲

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2025/09/25/scwk6j-1758769803399.jpg
Ghost of Yōtei sales appear to be trailing behind Ghost of Tsushima , but that doesn't mean it's not still pulling big numbers on PlayStation 5.

That's according to Alinea Analytics head of marketing analysis Rhys Elliott, who shared data related to Sucker Punch Productions' 2025 sequel on X/Twitter . Although this is sales information that has yet to be confirmed by Sony, it may still give us a peek behind the curtain at how Ghost of Yōtei has fared on PS5.

The result: Sucker Punch's action follow-up has done well in its first year, even if it hasn't quite managed to pass up its predecessor. Alinea's analysis puts Ghost of Yōtei sales at about 5.4 million units, generating $407 million in revenue so far. Highlights from that update put the physical slice at a notable 36.8%, while PlayStation Store discounts remain largely few and far between.

Around 500,000 copies were sold in Q3 2026 alone. Alinea also reported that 50,000 players have picked up the digital Complete Edition – which comes with new content, including the recently released Echoes of Sekigahara expansion – in the two weeks since PlayStation launched it as a replacement for the digital base game. With the analysis estimating that around 6% of its existing base returned to play the new content, it seems Ghost of Yōtei is going strong – but there is more to the story.

Ghost of Tsushima, which launched in a market still coming to grips with pandemic lockdowns in July 2020, had generated about $418 million by the same point in its lifespan, Elliott added in a follow-up post. Factoring in Yōtei's base price of $70 vs Tsushima's base price of $60, as well as any discounts that followed, the latter is estimated to have sold almost 7 million copies by this point.
That puts Tsushima moving at a much faster pace in terms of raw units sold, but there is more at play here, especially considering revenue is almost neck and neck.

How do Ghost of Yotei’s revenues compare to Tsushima’s? Our estimates (@alineaanalytics) show that Yotei has generated revenue of $407M. At this point, launch-aligned, Ghost of Tsushima had made $418M, so about 3% more. As Yotei costs $70, and has had just two discounts, and Tsushima was $60 at launch (and was already discounted to $45 less than three months post-launch), Tsushima had sold more copies at this point. Nearly 7M versus Yotei’s 5.4M. This is about 26% more revenue per buyer, which is consistent with PlayStation’s goal of extracting more revenue per player. While that’s quite the gap in terms of copies, it’s worth noting that by this point in Tsushima’s lifecycle, there were about 117M PS4s and 10M PS5s in the wild, versus the nearly 100M PS5s currently out there right now (Yotei’s only platform). That said, Yotei’s revenue is beginning to flatten more than Tsushima’s did, but perhaps the GTA-driven influx of new PS5s will soften that. Yotei has proven to be an evergreen seller in a crowded market, shifting 1.8M copies this year ($121M in revenue) despite having just two small discounts and competing with what is one of the busiest and highest-quality release calendars … ever. So yeah, anyone who says that Ghost of Yotei is a flop is flat-out wrong. (Note: the Y-axis starts at $392M. Otherwise, the chart wouldn’t be readable, as the numbers are so close)

"While that’s quite the gap in terms of copies, it’s worth noting that by this point in Tsushima’s lifecycle, there were about 117M PS4s and 10M PS5s in the wild, versus the nearly 100M PS5s currently out there right now (Yōtei's only platform)," Elliott explained. "That said, Yōtei's revenue is beginning to flatten more than Tsushima’s did, but perhaps the GTA-driven influx of new PS5s will soften that."

In other words, although Ghost of Tsushima had managed to move more copies by this point after its launch, Ghost of Yōtei is holding its own. Early estimates after the sequel's launch also had it falling in line with the original game , with Sony going on to confirm in February of this year that the follow-up "exceeded" Tsushima's sales and "significantly contributed" to its financial results for that quarter. As Elliott clarified today, "anyone who says that Ghost of Yōtei is a flop is flat-out wrong."

Ghost of Yōtei launched in October 2025 and is exclusive to PS5. IGN gave it an 8/10 review , saying, "A predictable but well-executed story takes you through Ghost of Yotei's gorgeous landscapes and satisfying, fluid action – it may not be revolutionizing open world games, but it's a great distillation of the samurai fantasy." It recently added a new armor set based on PlayStation's The Last of Us .

content.v: 前《战争机器》制作人劳拉·弗莱尔（Laura Fryer）认为，在《战争机器：事变日》中，系列主角马库斯·菲尼克斯被边缘化。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261017/1792243759_450945.jpg
在体验这款前传作品后，她分享了自己的看法：
“我参与过前两部作品的开发，本来很期待了解这个系列的背景故事，但真正玩起来后，我发现了一些问题。游戏的枪战手感依然很有《战争机器》的味道，场景也相当精美，但在战役模式中，那些本该属于英雄的高光时刻，却被交给了其他人。”
和许多玩家一样，弗莱尔原本期待游戏能够重点刻画马库斯与多姆之间的深厚友谊。 然而，在几个关键场景中，两人却沦为了旁观者，聚光灯反而落在了布拉沃小队的其他成员身上。这也让她对游戏剧情的整体评价打了折扣。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261017/1792245338_905680.jpg
弗莱尔特别提到了一段涉及兽族（Locust）出入口的剧情。在她看来，本该由马库斯亲自摧毁这个出入口，结果完成这一英雄壮举的却是玛格斯·卡特（Mags Carter）。
弗莱尔认为，这样的安排削弱了马库斯作为系列核心动作英雄的地位。尤其是对于单人游玩的玩家来说，他们原本期待亲自操控马库斯完成这些激动人心的英雄时刻，如今却失去了这样的体验。

others.title: 《使命召唤》新作Steam国区褒贬不一！全球特别好评

content.v: 在过去几年里，《使命召唤》系列逐渐淡出人们的视野。粉丝们抱怨游戏玩法重复、缺乏创新，但单人战役模式也令人非常失望，导致了很多负面评价。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261017/1792243062_741128_jpg_r.jpg
抢先体验期间，Steam整体好评率84%
然而，今年推出的《使命召唤：现代 战争 4》却被粉丝和媒体誉为该系列多年来最好的单人战役。它标志着线性游戏玩法的回归，并包含两条引人入胜、相互交织的故事情节。
大多数媒体都认为《使命召唤：现代战争4》的战役模式回归了系列巅峰。此外，该游戏在Steam上的抢先体验版也取得了不错的开局，获得了大量好评。其更加黑暗且内容丰富的故事情节备受赞誉。
新战役与以往的战役有很多不同之处。首先，虽然时长仍然只有8-9小时，但比最近的其他战役要长，这有助于丰富叙事内容。
全新的战役完全从零开始构建，加入了全新的自定义场景，例如白雪皑皑的朝鲜。此外，由于采用了动态角色切换，剧情推进也显得更加自然流畅，不再那么刻意。
此外，人物塑造非常出色，最终迎来了一个令人满意的结局。这可能是《使命召唤》系列中重启的《现代战争》系列的最后一次亮相，如果真是如此，那他们也算是完美谢幕了。

news.title: 《GTA6》全球评级全部完成！全成人级落地 坐等发售
news.summary: 《GTA6》全球评级完成：韩国开出的19+是最后一站，游戏将于11月19日发售。

content.v: 据X上的Rockstar爆料账号videotech10月17日发布的消息，《GTA6》已在全球所有主要市场完成评级，韩国是最后一个完成评级的主要市场。当地时间10月16日，韩国游戏内容分级委员会（GCRB）给出19+（仅限成人）的分级结果，这意味着《GTA6》发售前的最后一道监管流程已经走完。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/17/small_202610172054427686.png
从各地结果看，分级与该系列一贯的风格一致：美国、加拿大和墨西哥为ESRB M（17岁以上），欧洲为PEGI 18，德国USK 18，日本CERO Z，澳大利亚和新西兰R18+，巴西18+，沙特阿拉伯和阿联酋21+，韩国19+。据韩国媒体介绍，《GTA6》因包含强烈的暴力、性内容描写而拿到成人分级。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/17/small_202610172056302942.png
韩国此次评审由GCRB作出。2025年11月1日起，PC和主机游戏“仅限成人”级别的评审权从GRAC移交至私营的GCRB，《GTA6》是移交后受关注度最高的一次评审。其前作《给他爱5》2013年在韩国同样获得成人分级，此后顺利发售。
在此之前，R星已于10月1日悄悄更新了PS5和Xbox Series X|S商店页面的年龄分级信息，全球各区的ESRB、PEGI等评级随之从暂定转为正式，当时就有玩家发现商店页面出现了变化。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/17/small_202610172243083631.jpg
截至目前，官方已放出两部预告片、100多张截图和一支27分钟加长实机演示，并推出了限定手柄与收藏版。随着各大市场评级全部落地，《GTA6》已进入发售倒计时。

news.title: 我们与 D&D 游戏设计师 James Wyatt 坐下来讨论《龙与地下城：魔兽世界》
news.summary: At New York Comic Con, I got a chance to sit down with Wizards of the Coast Principal Game Designer James Wyat

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/03/342305-cn-copy-1791050958738.jpg

Dungeons & Dragons: World of Warcraft is less than a month away, and it already looks like it's going to be a massive expansion to the tabletop game. But there are still a lot of questions about whether this new expansion is going to lean more towards the combat-oriented approach of the MMO or just be a traditional D&D game on Azeroth.

At New York Comic Con, I got a chance to sit down with Wizards of the Coast principal game designer James Wyatt to talk about the first Universes Beyond expansion for D&D. From how he was talking about the expansion, it really does sound more like a D&D game taking place on Azeroth than trying to shove WoW's complicated mechanics and combat focus on the TTRPG.

IGN: I know that there are a lot of people who play both WoW and D&D, and I've heard some WoW players say that this is going to get them into D&D. Does the Expansion have a good on-ramp for those players?

James Wyatt: That is not its purpose, but I think it is a fantastic on-ramp in terms of someone who's a WoW player. Sitting down to make a D&D character, you're like, "Okay, what's a Tiefling? What's a Dragonborn? And what do these classes mean?" Whereas if you have that foundation of here's the WoW species, here's the WoW classes, you know the kind of character you want to make right away. This can help you steer and make those choices as a new player. We also have a very brief introductory "What is D&D?" just in case you don't know or for people who aren't familiar with it. And we steer you to D&D Beyond in particular as a place to find resources to help you get started.
So yeah, we took this down for a playtest at Blizzard last fall in the early stages, and Blizzard employees who had signed up, they signed up blind for a playtest of something. They didn't know what.

And so some of them were like, "Woo, D&D. Yes, I love D&D." And others are like, "Okay, I've never played it before. How does this go?" And I always love playing with new players because they don't know what they're supposed to do. So they are more willing to try anything they can imagine, which to my mind is really what the game is all about.

I was just telling the story of the guy who was playing the Forsaken Warlock who decided that, because he had no lower jaw, he couldn't properly cast spells. So his first spell backfired and knocked him down the stairs. And so then he tore off his own arm and threw it at the monster.
And, awesome! That's Dungeons & Dragons in a nutshell. It's not "What buttons do I have to press?" It's "What can I imagine and how do I do that? What does it look like?"

IGN: Yeah. Speaking of the combat, I know that there's a selection of dungeons that have been poured into the game, but obviously there are just too many dungeons in World of Warcraft to bring all of them over. So why did you pick the dungeons that you picked?

Wyatt: There were a couple of factors that went into that. One of them is that we started with this section on conflicts of Azeroth, which outlines the six conflicts that really have been the driving forces behind most of the expansions of WoW and talk about how they shape the world, and how you might bring them into a campaign.

All of the dungeons, I think, tie into these themes. That was one of the things that we used as a selection criteria is, does it reflect the themes of the conflicts that we're trying to emphasize here? So that was one. I was looking at popularity ranking on some wiki as another factor, just trying to get at what Dungeons people love and what's resonant for them. We started with a much larger list, made it smaller. So then it was what can we do in the space that we have and what works for the various level ranges of characters and that sort of thing.

IGN: There are some people who are probably going to want to see more of the raids. I think the only raid that I saw on the list was Onyxia's Lair, I might be mistaken. But will people be able to create their own Icecrown Citadel?

Wyatt: Icecrown Citadel, we are doing as a digital download adventure. We have a separate map pack that has five double-sided poster maps that are the boss fights from Icecrown Citadel. And that comes with a code for a digital download of the Icecrown Citadel adventure. So you can play through that. But I ran Blackfathom Deeps 20 years ago. It was just downloading the map from the internet and making up stats for Nagas at the time. And so using the tools in this book, you can absolutely adapt any dungeon you want to.
IGN: I saw some people concerned that this will be too focused on combat and having prescriptive dungeons. What would you say to that?

Wyatt: I think that's kind of the opposite of what we were going for, because the beauty of D&D is that when you walk into Shadowfang Keep, you can talk to anybody you meet, you can interact with anything you can see. And so the possibilities just open up tremendously over what a developer can program into any game, no matter how much care they're putting into it, because you have a DM at the table who can improvise and decide what happens.

So the dungeons that are presented here are given a pretty light touch and it's sort of like, okay, here's the dungeon map, here's the pins in the map that mark the bosses that we know you're going to encounter at some point. And what happens in between is largely a matter of improv and that you can roll on tables to generate encounters if you want a combat encounter, but you can also do something where you're exploring the environment in a way that you can't necessarily do in the MMO.

IGN: I take it that even the adventure hooks that you have open on that page there of Dire Maul, I'm sure people can create their own adventure hooks and assign their own reputation rewards and everything like that.
Wyatt: Yeah.
IGN: So this is for people who are familiar with Dungeons & Dragons at large. This is more of a guideline of how to play a game within World of Warcraft than anything else.

Wyatt: Yes, exactly. It is a great big toolbox. I mean, that's how I describe most of the books that I work on. I don't write a lot of adventure products. I do a lot of source books, and really there's that sense of we've got character options, we've got monsters, we've got dungeons you can explore. We've got guidelines for crafting your own campaign, and we've got just a big blank slate for you to play with.

IGN: World of Warcraft's obviously an evolving game that never really sits in one place. This goes up to the beginning of Midnight. Obviously, there's going to be more stories that come out over time. Are there going to be supplemental products or will it just be like, we gave you the tools, you know the story, kind of do your own thing with it?

Wyatt: Who knows? Okay, I keep saying that if I get to do another World of Warcraft book, I might postpone my retirement a little bit in order to work on it because I had so much fun working on this, loved it so much. And that depends entirely on my relationship with Blizzard and how things go from here, but I would love to do more.

news.title: 当《地平线》老兵请来了《皮囊》的编剧，我们终于等到了剧情类赛车游戏？
news.summary: 作者：柏亚舟 我们确实很久没有在赛车游戏品类看到真正意义上的“破局者”了。 当然，这不是说现在的市场上缺少优秀的赛车游戏。不管你是想在玩拟真的去磕“全圈速提升”，还是想玩开放世界去“欣赏风景”，你都还算有得选。不过对我个

content.v: 作者：柏亚舟
我们确实很久没有在赛车游戏品类看到真正意义上的“破局者”了。
当然，这不是说现在的市场上缺少优秀的赛车游戏。不管你是想在玩拟真的去磕“全圈速提升”，还是想玩开放世界去“欣赏风景”，你都还算有得选。不过对我个人私心而言，和朋友聊赛车游戏的时候，还是能想起小时候玩《极品飞车：最高通缉》的震撼体验，危险、刺激，玩游戏也像看电影。
在和Mike Brown 和Ben Penrose聊这些时，他们也同样会心一笑。

先介绍一下他们，两人分别是前《极限竞速：地平线》系列创意总监（Mike Brown）和艺术总监（Ben Penrose），如今，他们带着约40名前 Playground Games 的老兵，以及来自《驾驶俱乐部》、《摩托风暴》等经典赛车游戏的开发者，组建了全新的 Maverick Games 工作室，并带来了他们的野心之作——《CLUTCH》（中文名：《离合：红线》，下文仍简称“CLUTCH”）。
https://image.gcores.com/13ebfb7d66ea8497338f825426d20da4-4000-2666.jpg
十一期间的小红书 Redland ，机核在复兴岛见到了Mike和Ben，在试完了《CLUTCH》之后和他们进行了专访。在访谈中Mike和Ben敞开心扉，聊到了离开Playground的原因，以及在《CLUTCH》里想要实现的野心与突破。
他们也并不避讳对机会的发掘，至少在他们眼中，“汽车文化”的下一个爆发之地，就是中国。
https://image.gcores.com/3bee749e99736d0feb02d7c2fbe07f55-6000-4001.jpg
注：本次采访由 DENMU Edition 组织/统筹。DENMU Editions 是投资基金 DENMU 旗下负责营销与联合发行业务的部门。在中国，它担任 CLUTCH 团队的协调方兼本地对接方，为其 REDLAND 展台提供协助和设计支持，并负责其与中国本地媒体的联络。此前，DENMU Editions 已在中国为其他作品提供过同类服务，例如小高和刚的《百日战纪 -最终防卫学园》。
01 逃离“成功的诅咒”与时长陷阱
为什么放着已经大获成功的《地平线》系列不做，非要出来自立门户？这是我提出的第一个问题，显然也是很多玩家关心的问题。
Mike 的的回答其实很简单：当一个商业公式取得了巨大成功，资本和商业运作便不再允许你承担任何风险。“他们只希望你把同样的事情一遍遍重做。”这种“成功的诅咒”对创作者而言，意味着动力的枯竭与无聊。
https://image.gcores.com/b72dcece1b187e34d2cf70700a8b850e-739-415.jpg
两位“行业老兵”其实无意对自己曾经深爱的游戏有任何的贬损，只是在更深层的商业模式的变迁下，他们自己“渴望变化”的时机已经到来。在《地平线》系列这个早已成功的IP里，在XGP为重要玩家来源的模式当中，衡量游戏商业价值的核心指标变成了“玩家的总游玩时长”。
当游戏设计的终极目标变成了“如何让玩家尽可能久地留在游戏里”时，那些真正具有颠覆性、令人激动的新想法，往往会被稳妥的“刷子”机制所取代。这是他们的一个核心的无奈之处。
《CLUTCH》或许可以算得上是“压抑环境”下的产物。
Maverick Games 工作室的目标，是创造一个沉浸式剧情赛车游戏，它不追求让你漫无目的地刷上几百个小时，用主创们的话说，他们想要用一个有深度的单机沉浸式故事，重新唤醒玩家对赛车“危险与刺激”的原始渴望。
02 《皮囊》编剧操刀的“双面世界”
为了讲好这个故事，《CLUTCH》做出了一个在如今赛车游戏里很少的设定：放弃玩家自定义捏脸，采用固定的双主角设定——兄妹 Theo 和 Cass。
习惯了代入自我的玩家可能会感到不适，但如果你知道本作的首席编剧是谁，这种疑虑大概会瞬间打消——Jamie Brittain，英国经典青春剧《皮囊》（Skins）的编剧。
https://image.gcores.com/1b87d50b88cd4b53cd24f2896ac20f33-1200-900.png
这是他首次涉足游戏界。《皮囊》以刻画年轻人叛逆、混乱、细腻且极具破坏力的情感关系而闻名，我个人也算是《皮囊》的老粉丝，更重要的是仔细一想，这个剧的特质简直是“街头赛车故事”的绝配。
Mike 和 Ben 认为，如果要讲述一个足够深刻、充满张力的故事，“主角可以是任何人”的设定会让叙事变得单薄。兄妹之间那种既能互相扶持，又能互相伤害、开玩笑的复杂家庭羁绊，是推动剧情前行的核心动力。
这种张力同样体现在游戏的世界观设定中。《CLUTCH》构建了一个极具冲突感的“双面世界”：一边是百年历史、伟光正的R1K职业锦标赛；另一边则是更隐秘、更注重自我表达[XF1] 、全程在网络直播的地下街头圈子 Midnight Collective。
https://image.gcores.com/75689f71e8b8f8aca2871f95c0c9a70d-1920-1080.jpg
在不算长的游戏试玩当中，玩家就分别体验了锦标赛（竞速模式）和追逐战（剧情模式），主创介绍说，受人尊敬的职业车手在暗处沦为“逃亡车手”，这种双重身份的拉扯，正是编剧团队想要为玩家呈现的戏剧核心。
03 你的副驾有脏衣服吗？
如果说剧情是《CLUTCH》的骨架，那么独特的车辆定制系统依然会是它的灵魂。
传统赛车游戏的改装往往追求一种“展厅质感”——车漆永远锃亮，内饰一尘不染。但 Ben 在采访中提出了一个非常迷人的概念：“生活气息（lived-in feel）”。
在《CLUTCH》中，你可以决定车内有多脏，仪表盘上是否落了灰尘；你可以在后视镜上挂空气清新剂，甚至可以把刚脱下来的脏衣服随手扔在副驾驶座上。汽车不再是一个冰冷的竞速工具，而是你在混乱街头中的移动避难所，是你个人生活空间的延伸。
https://image.gcores.com/b49917f2e528956fdead6d829db126f8-1920-1080.png
这种设计的背后，是对汽车文化演进的深刻洞察。在 Mike 对汽车文化的理解里，汽车在人类社会的发展经历了三个阶段：从纯粹的“实用工具”，到彰显身份的“奢侈品”，最终必定会走向“自我表达”的载体。
为了鼓励这种自我表达，《CLUTCH》在 Midnight Collective 赛事中引入了破天荒的奖励机制：“创造力与比赛名次同等重要（being rewarded equally for both creative flair and finishing position）”。
在这个赛事里，只要你的驾驶风格足够华丽，只要你的车改得足够有个性，哪怕你开的不是最快的顶级超跑，直播间里的观众依然会为你投票，让你获得等同于冠军的丰厚奖励。在这里，个性比马力更受尊重。 [XF2]
04 这游戏还有 PvPvE？
除了剧情驱动，《CLUTCH》还在玩法上做出了大胆的尝试：3v3vAI 的 PvPvE 的“抢夺模式”。 [XF3]
想象一下这样的场景：两支玩家队伍潜入一个宏大的庄园派对，目标是在富豪毁掉绝世红酒之前将其偷走。大家开局只能驾驶慢速车辆，需要在场地内搜寻带有特殊科技模块的强力赛车。当你抢到红酒后，不仅要面对另一支玩家队伍的疯狂撞击和抢夺，还要应付穷追不舍的 AI 安保团队。
最有趣的是，这个模式里的 AI 并不是单纯的背景板——它们是真的可以获胜的。
https://image.gcores.com/a9d9ede5d96e6a44f2279315c316ae91-1920-1080.jpg
如果玩家队伍表现太差，安保团队成功将物品护送回安全区，AI 就会拿下这局。这种不可控的“无脚本混乱（unscripted chaos）”，让每一局游戏都充满了戏剧性和尖叫声。
总的来说，《CLUTCH》并不是想再造一个《地平线》，它更像是一个在极其成熟的品类里，带着一腔热血和叛逆精神杀回来的老兵。
虽然开玩笑地说，老兵这个词在这些年有些褒贬不一，佳作和烂作都有，但在访谈过后，我还是至少在这个阶段对《CLUTCH》保有信心。
05 完整访谈实录
采访者：
机核（微信公众号id：Gamecores）
受访人：
Mike Brown（Maverick Games 创始人兼创意总监，前《极限竞速：地平线》系列创意总监，下图左）
Ben Penrose（Maverick Games 艺术总监，参与开发《极限竞速：地平线》1-5代，下图右）
https://image.gcores.com/aac4f4ce7d4605fe2c42f5518e8f4da4-1707-1280.jpg
机核：我们先聊聊离开《极限竞速：地平线》系列开发公司（Playground Games）的契机吧，是什么促使你们创立 Maverick Games 这个新工作室，并决定继续做一款赛车游戏的？
Ben：我从第一代《地平线》起就在团队里了，从概念美术一路做到艺术总监，参与了1到5代的开发。 离开的主要动机是想做点不一样的东西。
我们组建的新团队里有很多人，包括 Mike，大家都充满激情，想在我们已经取得卓越成就的赛车品类里继续创新。 就像 Mike 常说的，我们想去做那些在《地平线》框架下根本没法做的事情。
Mike：我是从《地平线2》加入的，最初是高级设计师，后来成了系列的创意总监。 我们在那里度过了一段非常棒的时光，做了很多很棒的东西。 但是，当你身处创意行业想要尝试新事物时，往往会遇到一种“成功的诅咒”。
当游戏变得极其成功时，商业层面就不希望你再去搞什么创意了，他们只希望你把同样的事情一遍遍重做，不承担任何风险。 这对我们创作者来说非常缺乏动力，如果不继续前进、不做新东西，你面临的就是变得无聊的风险。 相比于待在一个不需要创新的安全区，我们更想自己出来组建一个最棒的团队，去做一些品类里未曾有过的新尝试。
https://image.gcores.com/92d317a51814bd5078542a8e982bcd15-1920-1080.jpg
机核：下一个问题可能稍微有一点敏感。在很多玩家看来，现在的《Forza》确实有一些往持续运营（GaaS）的角度走。这会不会也是你们想要离开，转而用《CLUTCH》去做一款偏单机、沉浸式剧情体验游戏的核心原因？
Mike：关于《Forza》的微交易，其实它在这方面的商业比重没有大家想的那么大。 它的商业模式更多是被 Game Pass 驱动的。
在 Game Pass 模式下，工作室赚钱的标准是看玩家的“总游玩时长”。 所以游戏设计的驱动力是为了让玩家一直玩下去，而不是微交易本身。但这其实也不是阻碍我们创意的核心原因，当时 Game Pass 是微软的重心，我们也确实为之做了优化设计。
真正让我们觉得受限的，还是之前说的——当你拥有一个极其成功的商业公式时，去改变它的意愿就会变得极低，因为商业上不允许你去冒险。

news.title: 《GTA6》被评18禁 两大主角可携带并随时吸食违禁品
news.summary: 《GTA6》似乎又为该系列已经庞大的“不良嗜好”清单增添了一项。除了脱衣舞俱乐部、暴力劫车和肆意杀戮之外，根据新的年龄分级，游戏中还加入了“频繁且突出”的毒品使用，玩家可以“随时”尝试。《GTA6》最近获得了PEGI 1

content.v: 《GTA6》似乎又为该系列已经庞大的“不良嗜好”清单增添了一项。除了脱衣舞俱乐部、 暴力 劫车和肆意杀戮之外，根据新的年龄分级，游戏中还加入了“频繁且突出”的毒品使用，玩家可以“随时”尝试。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261017/1792241342_923684_jpg_r.jpg
《GTA6》最近获得了PEGI 18+年龄评级，该评级信息被上传到泛欧洲游戏信息委员会网站后又迅速被删除，但在此之前，粉丝们已经保存并分享了该列表的详细信息。
PEGI的描述基本涵盖了《GTA》系列游戏应有的内容：谋杀、抢劫、枪支犯罪、其他非法勾当以及大量的脏话。 而这部第六部正统续作的新亮点，似乎允许玩家自由使用毒品。
已被删除的评级报告写道：“ 游戏中毒品使用频繁且突出，玩家可以与其他玩家一起吸毒，也可以直接从物品栏中使用非法毒品，尤其值得注意的是，玩家可以随身携带可卡因，并随时直接从手中吸食 。”
虽然大多数GTA系列的故事都以毒品交易为主题，但系列主角们大多并不热衷于使用他们贩卖的毒品。《给他爱5》和《GTA Online》都提供了可选的吸食大麻烟枪，但它们通常只能在玩家拥有的公寓里找到，而不能在游戏世界中随身携带。
今天早些时候的另一份年龄评级报告显示，《GTA6》可能是首款直接描绘性爱场景的《GTA》系列游戏，而PEGI的评级信息也证实了这一点：“游戏中包含强烈的性主题，包括裸露、性交场景以及偶尔出现的性癖好场景。在各种夜总会中，玩家还可以付费观看私人舞蹈，期间，游戏允许玩家将手放在舞者的胸部和臀部上。”
最后，不出所料，游戏中也出现了暴力元素，这对于Rockstar Games来说已是惯例。PEGI表示，玩家可以“以高度逼真的方式伤害环境中的所有其他角色”。某些武器显然会“造成更严重的伤害，例如更细致的斩首和肢解”。
Rockstar开发人员一直在吹嘘他们如何大幅提高了《GTA6》 “重新设计”的天气系统以及游戏中其他各个方面的细节，因此更加真实的暴力场面可能并不令人惊讶。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/thumbnews/20260720/1784518943_551412.jpg

news.title: PS6最新传闻！定价或超6700 索尼:不打算亏本卖硬件
news.summary: 索尼就PS6定价表态：原则上不打算以显著亏损销售硬件，同时称将继续关注市场、评估定价策略。

content.v: 据GameRant报道，AI需求推高内存与固态硬盘价格，次世代主机成本大涨，定价问题持续引发关注。索尼在投资者问答中就下一代主机的定价策略作出回应：原则上不打算以显著亏损的价格销售硬件，同时将继续关注市场、评估策略。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/17/small_202610172038201073.jpg
索尼表示，硬件是提供游戏体验的基础，公司还希望借PS Portal等产品把体验拓展到客厅以外。定价方面，索尼称“作为原则，我们不打算以显著亏损销售硬件”，并强调会让玩家理解定价对应的价值。索尼还提到，日本以外市场已实施过提价，销售符合预期，需求未见明显下滑。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/17/small_202610172040274404.jpg
售价预期方面，据硬件爆料人KeplerL2透露，PS6物料成本已从3月的约760美元（约合人民币5100元）涨至接近1000美元（约合人民币6710元），DRAM与SSD涨价是主因。参考PS5 Pro已达900美元（约合人民币6040元）的售价，分析机构Aldora的CEO认为下一代主机“1000美元是起步价”，发售也可能推迟到2028年。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/17/small_202610172041153081.png
微软新一代Xbox代号“Helix”，业界普遍预计两家都将在2027年推出新机，但索尼尚未确认发售窗口与定价，称需观察内存供应形势后再作决定。微软、任天堂等厂商也已因零部件涨价调整售价，Valve公布的Steam Machine售价同样超过1000美元（约合人民币6710元）。
主机行业历来有亏损卖硬件、靠软件回本的传统，制造成本大涨的当下，新一代主机的定价将直接影响玩家的换机意愿。

content.v: 《GTA6/ 侠盗猎车6 》日本地区商品页面现已显示CERO Z评级，仅限18岁以上人群。日本版是否会调整 暴力 及性相关内容，目前尚未公布。

北美和欧洲的分级结果已于10月2日前后出现，但日本地区的PlayStation Store与Microsoft Store页面此前仍显示“审查中”，10月15日发布的上市宣传片也沿用了这一状态。距离计划发售日约一个月时，日本分级终于明确。

content.v: 《使命召唤：现代 战争 4》是该系列首个登陆任天堂Switch 2的游戏。在看到这款游戏在Switch 2上的首段实机画面和首批体验反馈后，我们又有了更多消息。多名正在抢先体验的玩家发现，《使命召唤：现代战争4》在Switch 2上的战役模式支持英伟达 DLSS。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261017/1792240497_624777_jpg_r.jpg
一些用户表示，和测试版相比，正式版开启这项技术后，游戏画面和运行流畅度都有明显提升。不过，官方公布的战役模式运行帧率仍是30 FPS。这样的改进让一些曾对测试版性能感到失望的玩家颇为意外，但DLSS究竟能带来多大影响，还需要更详细的测试才能确认。
《使命召唤：现代战争4》将于2026年10月23日登陆任天堂Switch 2，并在同一天登陆PS5、Xbox Series X/S和PC。官方确认，Switch 2版会提供完整功能，包括跨平台联机。此前，官方已经正式宣布游戏会登陆这台主机，并透露其Switch 2版的开发过程进展“顺利”。
此外，Switch 2版《现代战争4》还将支持鼠标模式和跨平台进度等功能。

news.title: 开发商取消了即将推出的恐怖饮酒游戏的公开演示，担心它会立即被人工智能氛围编码员克隆：“我们对仓促通知表示诚挚的歉意”
news.summary: Alliance Arts will instead host "closed sessions" for Drunken Goddess Reflux.

content.v: The developer of an upcoming horror drinking game has cancelled plans for a public Steam demo in favour of private preview sessions, citing concerns that AI vibe coders might use the demo's content to clone the game.

Drunken Goddess Reflux is a "shot glass Russian roulette" drinking game where players square off against an anime demon girl who loves you but also kind of wants to murder you (which sounds like a standard relationship to me), with the goal of getting your girl-frenemy so blotto that she barfs up her soul. Frankly, it doesn't sound like my cup of tequila, although there is a mechanic where the rules of the game grow weirder and wilder the more alcohol you imbibe—which sounds neat.

Regardless, developer Alliance Arts planned to release a Steam demo on October 19, but in a post on X (via Rock, Paper, Shotgun ), the studio explained this is no longer the case. Instead, the studio will host "closed online play sessions for a limited number of participants."

"We sincerely apologize for the short notice," Alliance Arts added, before explaining its reasoning behind the demo's cancellation. Apparently, the demo would have come with "some restrictions on posting and streaming gameplay videos", which Alliance Arts decided it wouldn't be able to properly manage.

On top of this, however, the devs are also worried the demo will be exploited to create AI-coded clones. "We're concerned that the demo's content could be used to quickly imitate or replicate the game's presentation and gameplay with AI or other tools, and that such works could be released before launch."

It isn't clear which of these was Alliance Art' bigger worry, but game developers having their projects vibe-cloned is becoming a more frequent issue. Back in March, a developer shared her game prototype online only to have it cloned within five hours . This isn't the only example either, over on Bluesky, McPixel developer Sos Sosowski shared numerous examples of indie game developers having their works almost instantly copied by AI cloners and released on Steam.

Games being flagrantly copied is not a new problem—the mobile space has struggled with it for years. But the way AI tools have sped up the process is clearly a cause for concern among developers—especially since one of the best ways to improve a game's chance of success in today's crowded market is to share the idea early and build a community around it. As such, unless Valve and other game stores take a firmer stance against outright copycats, we may well see more developers adopt Alliance Arts' approach.
